transcript.text: Hi, thanks for making time. I wanted to check where we are with the app store screenshots.
Hello. We have finished the first version yesterday, but I am not sure about colors.
The background is very dark and the text is very small, so on the phone it is difficult to read.
Fair enough. We can try a lighter background and bump the font size. Anything else?
Yes, please explain me why you use the old logo. We have sent you the new one last month.
That's on us, sorry. The new logo got lost in the handover. I'll fix it today.
Okay, no problem. When we can see the next version?
By Monday morning, if that works for you.
It works. Thank you, have a nice weekend.
